content.text:
Done. Full repo unit suite green: **261 passed | 2 skipped | 1 todo** across 22 files.

## Audit result — `packages/react`

Only **3** bare `composeRefs(...)` call sites in render bodies repo-wide (all other ref usage is `useComposedRefs` — already memoized — or a plain pass-through `forwardedRef`):

| Site | Verdict | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `dropdown-menu.tsx:116` — `DropdownMenuTrigger` | **Same bug.** `ref={composeRefs(forwardedRef, context.triggerRef)}` — both values stable, closure fresh per render → ref re-attach on every trigger re-render | Fixed |
| `menu.tsx:1056` — `MenuSubTrigger` | **Same bug.** `ref={composeRefs(forwardedRef, subContext.onTriggerChange)}` — `onTriggerChange` is a stable `useState` setter; closure fresh per render | Fixed |
| `navigation-menu.tsx:1081` — `NavigationMenuViewportImpl` item map | **Same pattern, not fixed.** `ref={composeRefs(ref, (node) => { if (isActive && node) setContent(node); })}` | Left as-is, see below |

## Fixes (identical one-line pattern as slot)

- `dropdown-menu.tsx` — `const composedRefs = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, context.triggerRef)` before the return; `ref={composedRefs}`. Import switched `composeRefs` → `useComposedRefs`.
- `menu.tsx` — `const composedRefs = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, subContext.onTriggerChange)`; `ref={composedRefs}`. Dropped now-unused `composeRefs` import.

Both are unconditional hook calls in `forwardRef` render functions with no early returns — rules-of-hooks safe.

## Why navigation-menu:1081 was not fixed

- It sits **inside `Array.from(...).map()`** — a hook (`useComposedRefs`) cannot be used there.
- The inner closure **intentionally closes over per-render `isActive`** (only the active content node is tracked for the smooth transition), so it genuinely changes identity when the active item changes.
- The clean fix is extracting a per-item wrapper component — that inserts a **new element type into the tree** (remount risk for menu content on a patch upgrade), which is not a minimal, safe fix.
- Its own side effect (`setContent(node)` with the same node) bails out in React, so it can't self-loop; the residual exposure is only re-attach churn of the item's stored ref. Flagging it for a dedicated change rather than forcing it into this one.

## Verification

- New regression tests, each proven to **fail on HEAD source, pass on fixed source** (verified by swapping in `git show HEAD:` versions, then restoring):
  - `dropdown-menu/src/dropdown-menu.test.tsx` — stable ref not re-invoked on re-render; state-updating ref callback doesn't hit "Maximum update depth exceeded".
  - `menu/src/menu.test.tsx` — `MenuSubTrigger` stable ref not re-invoked on re-render (open menu via controlled `open`).
- `pnpm typecheck` + `pnpm lint` clean for both packages.
- `pnpm vitest run` (entire repo): 261 passed, 2 skipped (pre-existing), 1 todo.
